page.layout: One text column, with marginal notes in the left margin. Running head at the top: page number 390 at left, title "LIBRI SECUNDI" at right. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: latur extra vasa sua effusus, confectus calore temperato ex partibus chyli temperatioribus, pinguidioribus & aereis, praecipua nutrimenti portio.

Pituita.PITUITA eft humor primi generis, substantiae lentae & viscidae, colore subalbus, sapore insipidus fere, ex chylia-quosfis & crudis partibus, quae elaborari satis nequiverunt, excoctus, ulteriore tamen coctione sanguinis dulcedinem acquirens; dicitur & Phlegma.
Haec eft vel alimentaria, vel excre-mentitia.
Alimentaria quae cedit partibus quibusdam corporis in alimentum, praecipue in sanguinis defectu converfa in sanguinem.
Excrementitia quae ut inutilis ejicitur, quaeq; eft ratione substantiae, vel aquea, vel mucea, vel gypsea.
main_text.head: CAPUT XLIII. DE BILE FLAVA ET ATRA; ITEM DE VESICULA Fellis & Liene.
main_text.p: Secundi generis humores funt Bilis, cum Flava, tum Atra.

page.notes: Faint marginal marks in the left margin (below "Pituita.") are show-through or near-illegible and are not transcribed. Small-capital "PITUITA" and "CAPUT" are transcribed in capitals. The word "quosfis" is read with some uncertainty from the long-s ligature; it could be "quofis". The woodcut-style initial "S" of "Secundi" is joined to the word as the drop cap.
